label: NG US opening-range continuation into the close (September filter)
researchSummary: US opening continuation into the closing half-hour. Filter: month 9. True bracket exit uses 2:1 reward/risk; forward PF was recomputed from actual stop/target/time exits.
selectionMethod: Fixed session-edge research grid; pre-2022 training ranked candidates, then post-2022 forward trades had to clear PF/trade-count/split/no-duplicate gates. Management sweep promoted `be_trail_hourly_pivot_b0` only after strict forward PF improved from 3.14 to 3.28.
